bioconductor.name: onlineFDR
bioconductor.description: This package allows users to control the false discovery rate (FDR) or familywise error rate (FWER) for online multiple hypothesis testing, where hypotheses arrive in a stream. In this framework, a null hypothesis is rejected based on the evidence against it and on the previous rejection decisions.
bioconductor.author: David S. Robertson [aut, cre], Lathan Liou [aut], Aaditya Ramdas [aut], Adel Javanmard [ctb], Andrea Montanari [ctb], Jinjin Tian [ctb], Tijana Zrnic [ctb], Natasha A. Karp [aut]
